name: Mobbex

webhook.algorithm: UNKNOWN. Mobbex documents webhook delivery (JSON POST on status change: approved/rejected/expired, TLS 1.2+, configurable retries) but no signature header or algorithm was verifiable. API auth uses `x-api-key` and `x-access-token` headers generated from the console. Do NOT assume those headers are echoed on inbound webhooks. Generate a handler that re-fetches the transaction and dedups, and flag the gap.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: Headers `x-api-key` and `x-access-token`, both generated from the console's Developers section. No prefix pattern — leave null.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN. Argentine QR/card commissions reportedly range 0.8%–3.99% depending on funding source, but that is a market-wide figure, not Mobbex's rate card. Do not populate.

notes: The API-first Argentine alternative to Mercado Pago, with self-serve signup, a sandbox with simulated webhooks, and native support for installments (cuotas) and subscriptions — the three things Argentine checkout actually needs. Argentina currently has only mercadopago in providers.json.
SDKs: SDKs and platform plugins are advertised at mobbex.dev with a sandbox including test cards and simulated webhooks. Official server package names not verified.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Second AR option alongside mercadopago. Prefer Mobbex when the merchant wants a real API and marketplace split rather than Mercado Pago's checkout.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
